title: Stadium:
title_short: WSMO · Stadium · Game Day to Runway
headline: Sheri takes Buffalo from game day to runway: her invite from the stadium, the team's selfies and cheer, and the date, Thursday, November 5th at Highmark Stadium.
story: Same WSMO series style as the boutique and Mara Hoffman cuts. Sheri opens from the stadium on game day, invites everyone to the show, the team's selfies carry the middle, the whole group cheers <q>Go Women, Go Bills!</q>, and Sheri closes on the date.

Fix these in this version (Atdhe, Frame.io): the start of her first word is cut off. she is cut off here at the end of "runway" too. move this stuff off of her face. They say "Go Women! Go Bills!" In this clip, you are cutting out much of the "Go Women."
do: Start the hook a few frames before “Hello”, so the whole word is heard.
Keep every text and graphic off Sheri's face: hook text in the top band, super beside her.
Play IMG_4136 from its first frame, so the full “Go Women, Go Bills!” is heard.
Keep the series look: ombre open and close, purple caption boxes, the series end card.
dont: No logo, wordmark or name at 0:00.
Do not use IMG_2083 (the “Wives Association” take) or its copy IMG_2083 2.
No voice-over on the end card: Sheri already says the date.
Do not crop the group cheer to 9:16: it cuts people out.

decisions.b: Monday has no deadline for this item. The show is Thursday 5 Nov, so this version has to post before then. Nick sets the date.

decisions.t: Noisy end of the invite line
decisions.b: The end of Sheri's line, “celebrating fashion and community”, is noisy in the source. Nick confirms the words with Rebecca, or the line ends at “from football to the runway”.

The Bills logo shows on the stadium in IMG_4136 and on the jacket in IMG_2076. WNY asked to keep it out of the KP Made Me cut. This is the Bills partnership video, so it is likely fine here. Nick confirms.

client_note: Why this matters: this is the last WSMO promo before the show on Thursday 5 Nov. WNY's Bills partnership reel was their best reel this quarter.
